ops.en: THE OBJECTION. ve-HEN lo YAAMINU li — 'they will NOT BELIEVE me': the third demurral contradicts the promise of 3:18 ('they WILL hear your voice') — the machine files the tension the readings weigh (the readings' verdict on the slander of the believers named); lo nira elekha YHWH — the denial Moses scripts into their mouths: the chapter will spend four signs and thirty verses refuting this verse, …

THE QUESTION [EX04-02]. MA-ZE ve-yadekha — 'WHAT IS THIS in your hand?': written as ONE WORD (מזה — 'what-is-this' fused), read as two — one of the Masorah's FIFTEEN written-one-read-two, the Ramah's ruling, carried in the stream's own two-token convention (the unpointed written-form beside the pointed reading — both layers verified) [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-02]; Shemot Rabbah reads the seam: MI-Z…

DRILL ONE — THE PUSH [EX04-03]. HASHLIKHEHU artza — 'THROW IT to the ground': the command-token FULL yod (the printer's lean corrected by MS with the Masorah, Minchat Kohen, and the Ramah; census-unique, checked) [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-03]: the first of the four sign- drills — the machine will watch obedience execute inside the verse.

DRILL ONE — THE SAME-VERSE PERFORMANCE. va-YASHLIKHEHU artza va-yehi le-NACHASH — thrown, and it becomes a SERPENT (the serpent-word's career: the garden's speaker, gen_10; Laban's divining, gen_52's file — the corpus's oldest adversary-noun now a staff on the ground); and the second throw-word carries the run's named STREAM- SPLIT (the Ramah's eight-lean list reads it lean; the stream writes it f…

DRILL TWO — THE PUSH. SHELACH yadekha ve-ECHOZ bi-zenavo — 'SEND your hand and SEIZE it by the TAIL': the send-verb (the chapter's keyword — sent hands, sent words, the send-by-another plea coming) aimed at the thing Moses just fled: the machine pushes the counter- fear demand.

DRILL TWO — THE SAME-VERSE PERFORMANCE. va-yishlach yado va-YACHAZEQ bo — sent, and HELD FAST (the seize-verb chazaq — the word that will harden Pharaoh's heart, 4:21: the machine files the double career opening — the hand that grips the serpent, the heart that grips itself); va-yehi le-MATE be-khapo — staff again, in the PALM: two drills, two instant pops — the queue teaching the hand.

THE PURPOSE [EX04-13]. LEMAAN YAAMINU — 'THAT THEY MAY BELIEVE': the sign's charter — the believe-verb from 4:1's objection, negated there, purposed here (the machine matches the clause to its target); ki NIRA elekha — the appeared-word Moses scripted as denied ('the LORD has NOT appeared,' 4:1) affirmed with the three-fathers formula: the machine files the drill's law: every sign in this chapter …

DRILL THREE — THE PUSH [EX04-10; EX04-11]. HAVE-na yadekha be- CHEQEKHA — 'BRING, pray, your hand into your BOSOM': the bring-word of the Kitzur's three-station chain (by Joseph's bring-word they came down, by Moses' they go up, by the city-bring they gather — the descent-and-ascent between three imperatives) [VERIFIED under EX04-11]; the your-bosom word's Torah-three (Sarai's wrong, the sign here…

DRILL THREE — THE SAME-VERSE PERFORMANCE. va-yave yado be-cheqo... ve-hine yado METZORAAT ka-SHALEG — brought, and the hand comes out LEPROUS AS SNOW: the skin-sign (the readings: the slander of 4:1 answered in the slanderer's own skin — the leprosy-and-speech file the corpus will codify at the laws, lev_13's intake armed); the third instant pop: the machine notes the drill's escalation — first th…

DRILL FOUR — THE PUSH. HASHEV yadekha el-cheqekha — 'RETURN your hand': the restore-command — the machine notes the pedagogy: the sign runs BOTH directions on command (struck by word, healed by word — the plagues' own grammar rehearsed on the messenger's body).

DRILL FOUR — THE SAME-VERSE PERFORMANCE. va-yashev yado el-cheqo... ve-hine SHAVA ki-vesaro — returned, 'and behold, it RETURNED as his flesh': the fourth same-verse discharge — FOUR drills, four instant pops: the forward era's densest obedience-sequence (the corpus's queue-mechanics taught as a catechism: push, perform, close, inside one verse, four times running).

THE TWO VOICES [EX04-09]. le-QOL ha-ot ha-rishon... le-QOL ha-ot ha- ACHARON — the signs have VOICES (the readings: a sign SAYS something — the machine notes the letter granting speech to wonders); ha- acharon FULL vav with the precise manuscripts and the old print (asserted) [VERIFIED under EX04-09]: the conditional ladder built — first sign, latter sign, and the verse after holds the third rung.

THE THIRD SIGN [EX04-13]. ve-laqachta mi-meme ha-YEOR... ve-hayu le- DAM — Nile-water poured on the dry land becomes BLOOD: a CONDITIONAL instruction (the if-ladder's third rung) — the machine's fence holds: a contingent script installs no demand (the letter never narrates this sign performed for the people — the readings note the plague of blood, 7:20, as its enlargement) [VERIFIED under EX04-13]…

THE HEAVY MOUTH. lo ish DEVARIM anokhi — 'not a man of WORDS am I' (the man who will speak the book of Devarim — the readings' irony named); gam mi-temol gam mi-shilshom gam me-az daberkha — the three- fold also (the readings' seven-days-at-the-bush arithmetic named); ki KHEVAD-pe u-khevad LASHON anokhi — 'HEAVY of mouth and HEAVY of tongue': the kaved-word again (the heavy famine, the heavy camp …

THE MAKER'S CLAIM [EX04-07]. mi SAM pe la-adam — 'who SET a mouth for man'; o mi YASUM ilem — 'or who MAKES dumb': the make-word in the FUTURE form, its one Torah token — and the Kitzur reads the tense forward: 'the lying lips will be MADE DUMB at the day of judgment, and they will find no answer' [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-07]; the four offices (dumb, deaf, seeing, blind — the readings: the courtie…

THE REAFFIRMATION [EX04-05]. ve-ata LEKH — 'and now, GO': the go- word again — the machine pushes NO new demand: the commission of 3:10 still holds its card (a reissue is not a new debt — the one- world queue-law); ve-anokhi EHYE im-PIKHA — 'I will BE with your MOUTH': the ehye-word (the Name of 3:14) lodged at the mouth the demurral called heavy; ve-HORETIKHA — 'and I will TEACH you': the two-yod…

THE PLEA [EX04-09]. bi adonai SHELACH-NA be-yad TISHLACH — 'SEND, pray, by the hand You WILL SEND': the fifth demurral is a real petition — the machine pushes it (MS's pointing on the plea-words asserted [EX04-09]); the readings' hearings named, never merged (by Aaron's hand, the accustomed messenger; by the Messiah's hand, the last; by anyone's but mine); the next verses answer with ANGER and an …

THE BROTHER [EX04-01 MARQUEE]. va-yichar AF YHWH be-moshe — the anger burns (the readings' inventories of what the anger cost named, never merged); ha-lo AHARON achikha ha-LEVI — Aaron enters the book by name; ki daber YEDABER HU VE-GAM HINE — and the INITIAL LETTERS of the four words spell the FOUR-LETTER NAME (checked mechanically): 'He handed the Name and all its epithets to Aaron too' — the ru…

THE RELAY [EX04-05]. ve-dibarta elav ve-SAMTA et ha-DEVARIM be-fiv — 'PUT the words in his MOUTH': the relay-demand pushed (Moses to Aaron, the word-chain built — its performance armed at 4:28's telling); ve-anokhi ehye im-PIKHA ve-im-PIHU — 'with YOUR mouth and with HIS mouth': the ehye-presence doubled over both mouths; ve- HORETI etkhem — the teach-word's second Torah-unique token (the Samuel-p…

THE OFFICES [EX04-09]. ve-diber HU lekha el ha-am — HE speaks, for YOU, to the people: the relay's org-chart; ve-haya hu yihye-LEKHA le-FE — 'he shall be for you a MOUTH' (the lamed of the for-you DAGESHED — MS's dot checked in-stream; the fore-stress on the ve- haya named) [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-09]; ve-ata tihye-lo le-ELOHIM — 'and you shall be for him as GOD': the boldest office-word in the c…

THE STAFF-DEMAND [EX04-12]. ve-et ha-MATE ha-ze TIQACH be-yadekha — 'THIS STAFF you shall TAKE in your hand': the take-demand pushed (its pop three verses off, 4:20); the Kitzur's crown-file named — the NINTH righteous to hold the staff (the relay Adam, Enoch, Noah, Shem, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses: the corpus's oldest baton; crowns beyond the stream's layer) [VERIFIED under EX04-12]; as…

THE LEAVE-REQUEST [EX04-12]. va-yashav el YETER chotno — to JETHER (the shortened name — the Kitzur's pair with the exile-elders: 'his sons' sons sat in the Chamber of Hewn Stone,' the Sanhedrin from Midian's priest; the station checked) [VERIFIED under EX04-12]; ELKHA-na ve-ASHUVA el-ACHAI — 'LET ME GO, pray, and RETURN to my BROTHERS': the son-in-law petitions the household he joined (the readin…

THE SAME-VERSE GRANT. va-yomer yitro le-moshe LEKH LE-SHALOM — 'GO IN PEACE': the fifth same-verse discharge of the unit — asked and granted before the verse closes (gen_70's leave-request class); the readings on the two-word blessing named (le-shalom, toward peace — the errand blessed whole): the machine notes the queue's shape: the human courtesies pop instantly; the divine commissions stay open…

THE RETURN-DEMAND [EX04-08]. lekh SHUV mitzrayim — 'go, RETURN to Egypt': the return-imperative written LEAN — MS's unique-lean against the Kitzur's two-count with its seven-journeys midrash (the count-dispute carried named, never merged; the skeleton's homograph- census printed in the manifest) [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-08]; ki METU kol ha-anashim ha-MEVAQSHIM et nafshekha — 'all the men who SOUGH…

THE RETURN PERFORMED. va-YASHAV artza mitzrayim — 'and he RETURNED to the land of Egypt': 4:19's demand pops in the deed (the readings' donkey named — THE donkey: the saddled beast of the Binding and the King's poor-man mount, the chain's one relay-animal — named, beyond the stream's proof); the family mounted (Gershom of exo_02's registry; the second son the roster of 18:4 will name — registry re…

THE STAFF TAKEN. va-yiqach moshe et MATE ha-ELOHIM be-yado — 'the STAFF OF GOD': 4:17's take-demand pops — and the letter has promoted the object between push and pop (the staff of 4:2's your-hand is now GOD'S staff): the machine files the upgrade as the pop's own receipt — obedience renames the instrument.

THE WONDERS-CHARGE [EX04-09; EX04-13]. ree khol ha-MOFTIM asher samti ve-yadekha VA-ASITAM lifne FARO — 'see all the WONDERS... and DO them before Pharaoh': the charge pushed OPEN — its performance is the plague-cycle itself (the first staff-wonder before Pharaoh armed at 7:10); lifne faro on MS's wheel-mark against the stream's joining-stroke (the class's next station, named) [VERIFIED under EX04…

THE SON-SCRIPT [EX04-13]. ve-AMARTA el paro: ko amar YHWH BENI VEKHORI yisrael — 'MY SON, MY FIRSTBORN — Israel': the say-demand pushed (the scripted-speech class, third of the run) — and the my- firstborn word's exact Torah-PAIR carries the theology: JACOB'S to Reuben (the firstborn DEMOTED, 'you shall not excel,' Gen 49:3 — gen_72's testament) and GOD'S to Israel here (the nation ELECTED) [VERIF…

THE SCRIPT'S EDGE. SHALACH et beni ve-YAAVDENI — 'SEND My son that he may SERVE Me': the send-and-serve pair (the serve-verb of the bondage, 1:13, re-aimed at its Owner: the book's thesis in four words); va-TEMAEN le-shalcho — 'and you REFUSE': the refuse-verb (gen_71's dead-by-refusal class-word — the machine notes the letter pre-filing Pharaoh's refusals); hine anokhi HOREG et BINKHA BEKHOREKHA …

THE ATTACK [EX04-04]. va-YIFGESHEHU YHWH va-yevaqesh HAMITO — 'and the LORD MET him, and sought to KILL him': the met-word's exact Scripture-pair lives INSIDE this chapter — the attack here, Aaron's kiss at 4:27 (the Kitzur: 'when Moses was lax about the circumcision, Wrath and Fury came to swallow him... by Aaron's merit he was saved') [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-04]; the machine holds the seeking a…

THE DEED [exo_02's file]. va-tiqach TZIPORA TZOR — ZIPPORAH takes a FLINT: the bird-name at its second lean station (exo_02's three-lean file — the giving 2:21, the taking HERE, the wife-clause 18:2: the census verified there); va-TIKHROT et ARLAT benah — 'and CUT OFF the foreskin of her son': the machine's EVENT — the covenant of the flesh (gen_33's law) executed by a Midianite woman with a stone…

THE RELEASE [EX04-13]. va-YIREF mimenu — 'and He RELEASED him': the seeking of 4:24 ends at the blood (the machine files the mechanics: no demand was uttered at the inn — a standing menace, discharged by a deed the letter never commanded: the queue's strangest transaction); AZ amra CHATAN DAMIM la-MULOT — the second saying, now with the circumcision-word plural ('for the circumcisions' — the refer…

THE MEET-DEMAND [EX04-04]. va-yomer YHWH el-AHARON — the first recorded word of God TO Aaron in the book: LEKH liqrat moshe ha- MIDBARA — 'GO to meet Moses, to the wilderness': the demand pushed (the Kitzur's lean-yatza file named — the going already under way when the word came).

THE SAME-VERSE KISS. va-yelekh va-YIFGESHEHU be-har ha-elohim va- YISHAQ-lo — went, MET him at the mountain of God, and KISSED him: the sixth same-verse discharge — and the met-word's pair completes INSIDE the unit: met to be killed (4:24), met to be KISSED (here) — the Kitzur's by-Aaron's-merit binding the two stations [VERIFIED: manifest EX04-04]: the machine files the meeting-place: the mountai…

THE RELAY PERFORMED. va-YAGED moshe le-AHARON et KOL divre YHWH asher shelacho — 'Moses TOLD Aaron ALL the words': 4:15's words-in- his-mouth demand pops in the telling (the all-word doubled — all the words, all the signs: the letter certifies a complete handoff); asher TZIVAHU — 'which He had COMMANDED him': the machine notes the receipt-grammar (the command-verb closing the loop) and the org- ch…
